title: Go Basics
description: Go from zero to hero: 22 concepts, each taught by a lesson and drilled by two or three test-driven challenges. Syntax and values first, then the type system, then errors, generics and packages, and finally the parts of Go you cannot get anywhere else: goroutines, channels, sync and context. Every challenge is graded by tests you can read.

roadmap.title: Hello, Gofinity
roadmap.summary: Your first Go program: packages, func main, and returning a string from a function.

roadmap.title: Greeting Lines
roadmap.summary: Build a multi-line greeting with fmt.Sprintf and strings.Join.

roadmap.title: Variables and Constants
roadmap.summary: var versus :=, typed and untyped constants, and when each one reads better.

roadmap.title: Zero Values
roadmap.summary: What every type starts as before you assign it, and why Go has no uninitialised memory.

roadmap.title: Weekdays with iota
roadmap.summary: Enumerations built from iota, and giving them a String method.

roadmap.title: Type Conversions
roadmap.summary: Explicit conversion between numeric types, and the truncation you have to plan for.

roadmap.title: Runes and Bytes
roadmap.summary: A string is bytes; ranging over it yields runes. Counting either one correctly.

roadmap.title: Temperature Conversion
roadmap.summary: Integer and float arithmetic together, with rounding you control.

roadmap.title: FizzBuzz
roadmap.summary: if, else if, and the modulo operator, in the smallest program that needs all three.

roadmap.title: Grade Switch
roadmap.summary: switch without fallthrough, switch with no expression, and default.

roadmap.title: Loop Patterns
roadmap.summary: Go's one for loop as a counter, a while, a range and an infinite loop with break.

roadmap.title: Multiple Returns
roadmap.summary: Returning a value and an ok flag, named results, and the blank identifier.

roadmap.title: Variadic Sum
roadmap.summary: Variadic parameters, spreading a slice into one, and the empty-args case.

roadmap.title: Closure Counter
roadmap.summary: Functions as values, and closing over state that outlives the call.

roadmap.title: Defer Order
roadmap.summary: Deferred calls run last-in first-out, and their arguments evaluate immediately.

roadmap.title: Safe Divide
roadmap.summary: recover turning a panic into an error value at the boundary of a function.

roadmap.title: Cleanup with defer

roadmap.title: Slice Basics
roadmap.summary: Length versus capacity, slicing with low and high bounds, and out-of-range.

roadmap.title: Append and Copy
roadmap.summary: How append grows a slice, when it reallocates, and what copy actually copies.

roadmap.title: Slice Aliasing
roadmap.summary: Two slices sharing one array, and the bug that follows if you forget.

roadmap.title: Map Basics
roadmap.summary: Making a map, the comma-ok lookup, delete, and len.

roadmap.title: Word Count
roadmap.summary: Counting occurrences into a map, then sorting the keys for a stable answer.

roadmap.title: Map of Slices

roadmap.title: Strings Toolkit
roadmap.summary: Split, Join, TrimSpace, Fields, Contains and friends, used together.

roadmap.title: Parsing with strconv
roadmap.summary: Atoi, ParseFloat, ParseBool, and treating their errors as data.

roadmap.title: String Builder
roadmap.summary: Why += in a loop is quadratic, and what strings.Builder does instead.

roadmap.title: Struct Basics
roadmap.summary: Declaring a struct, literals with field names, and passing one by value.

roadmap.title: Struct Embedding

roadmap.title: Struct Equality
roadmap.summary: Which structs compare with ==, which do not, and how to compare the rest.

roadmap.title: Value versus Pointer Receiver

roadmap.title: Mutating Methods
roadmap.summary: Building a small type whose methods change its state, correctly.

roadmap.title: Pointer Safety

roadmap.title: The Shape Interface

roadmap.title: Type Switch

roadmap.title: Custom Error Type

roadmap.title: Number Constraints

roadmap.title: Capstone: Log Parser
roadmap.summary: Structs, interfaces, errors and concurrency combined on a realistic input.
